name: ahpd-workspace
description: An open-source, plugin-driven AHP server with native Claude and pi agents, ACP agents (Codex, Copilot, Gemini), model proxying, tools and MCP servers, sandboxed computers and terminals, automations, conversational bots, and a web UI (ahpw). Users, permissions and usage tracking are built in. Build your own host and plugins with @ahpd/sdk.
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/sdk && tsc -p packages/agent-claude && tsc -p packages/agent-cofold && tsc -p packages/agent-acp && tsc -p packages/agent-pi && tsc -p packages/computer && tsc -p packages/bot && tsc -p packages/push && tsc -p packages/webhook && tsc -p packages/tasks && tsc -p packages/tunnel-devtunnel && tsc -p packages/activepieces && tsc -p packages/server
scripts.test:processes: node tools/schema.mjs && vitest run packages/computer/ packages/server/test/server-cli packages/server/test/server-http packages/sdk/test/nested-process
